name: Kaltunk
summary: Kaltunk is an orc overseer stationed at the heart of the Valley of Trials in Durotar. He serves as the very first point of contact for young orcs taking their opening steps into the world. It is his duty to welcome these aspiring champions and direct them to their initial duties in service to the Horde.

sections.title: The First Step
sections.body: Standing under the harsh sun of the Valley of Trials, Kaltunk watches over the newly arrived hopefuls seeking to prove themselves worthy of the Horde. While other trainers and elders assign grueling trials and hunting rites, Kaltunk ensures that no recruit wanders aimlessly through the red dust. He delivers straightforward orders, pointing newcomers directly toward Gornek and the path of discipline.

sections.title: Keeper of the Valley
sections.body: The Valley of Trials is not an easy proving ground; it was chosen specifically to forge strength and resilience in every youth who walks its canyon floors. Kaltunk embodies this rugged practicality. He offers no grand speeches or coddling, expecting each orc to quickly find their place in the world and pull their weight for the warchief.

faq.answer: Kaltunk is an orc overseer stationed in the Valley of Trials. He is the very first person newly awakened orc adventurers encounter, tasked with pointing them toward their mentors and starting their training.

faq.q: What does Kaltunk do for new adventurers?
faq.answer: He gives new recruits their initial task, directing them to speak with Gornek elsewhere in the valley so their true training can begin.
He stands right near the central training tent and campfire within the Valley of Trials, the secluded starting grounds in southern Durotar.

faq.q: Why is he stationed in the Valley of Trials?
faq.answer: He serves as a welcoming overseer to ensure incoming orc recruits are organized and promptly set onto their path of service to Thrall's Horde.

angles.text: For every orc stepping out into Kalimdor, Kaltunk's gruff instructions are the first words they hear as they begin earning their honor.
Kaltunk helps uphold the practical discipline required to maintain order in the harsh proving grounds of Durotar.
